description: This Java class 'WorldPayEvents' handles integration with WorldPay payment gateway, including request initiation and notification handling, for the OFBiz e-commerce framework. It manages payment request redirection, processes asynchronous notifications, updates order/payment status, and interacts with various OFBiz services and entities.

classes.name: WorldPayEvents
classes.description: Main class providing static methods for handling WorldPay payment requests and notifications within OFBiz.

methods.name: worldPayRequest
methods.description: Prepares and redirects the user to the WorldPay payment gateway with order and customer details.

methods.name: worldPayNotify
methods.description: Handles asynchronous notifications from WorldPay, updating order status and sending confirmation emails.

methods.name: setPaymentPreferences
methods.description: Updates payment preferences and creates payment gateway response records based on notification data.

methods.name: setPaymentPreference
methods.description: Sets individual payment preference details, creates response records, and triggers payment creation services.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for the payment gateway, either from entity or properties.
